description: Normalization applied to source and target observation values before the integration harness compares them. Only process-observable facts are normalized.

rules.note: Trailing spaces/tabs are not part of the contract.
Repeated blank lines collapse to a single blank line.
Human-readable messages are compared only after whitespace/newline collapsing and containment; never matched whole.
Integers and floats denoting the same value compare equal.
Shell completion script bodies are compared for existence and shell markers only.
Errors compare by exit code / error kind first; message text only after whitespace normalization.
